sources.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production portrait4:5travel puzzle PAINTED CLEAN BACKGROUND. Scene: A sunlit glasshouse filled with ferns and potted plants. View: eye-level intimate view. Polished warm storybook digital painting matching the approved Art Direction V2 game boards: tactile softly brushed surfaces, gentle sunlight, dimensional illustrated objects, clean local colour separation and rich small discoveries. No flat vector art, no photographic collage, no generic geometric filler. Dominant main colour: coral pink (#D99B96), clearly occupying the largest coherent surfaces, with balanced contrasting details. Composition is generic travel subject matter; NO recognizable destination landmarks, city names, signs, letters or logos. No UI or border. This is a finished clean plate for five separately painted motion details. Paint complete underlying surfaces at all five declared positions; do not draw the five named foreground details, leave no transparent hole or blank placeholder. Portrait master1280x1600. Part placements for later composition: an upper-left branch of the scene-specific plant at normalised rect [0.07, 0.09, 0.23, 0.2]; an upper-right leaf cluster of a different scene plant at normalised rect [0.72, 0.14, 0.2, 0.2]; a lower-left flower or fern frond at normalised rect [0.08, 0.69, 0.21, 0.22]; a lower-right cluster of matching grass or foliage at normalised rect [0.71, 0.72, 0.22, 0.18]; a small soft cloud or reflected-water glint suited to this scene at normalised rect [0.4, 0.27, 0.2, 0.12]. The painting must remain attractive and complete underneath those parts.
Art direction: a sunlit intimate glasshouse painted in gentle coral-pink walls, pink stone floor and weathered coral window mullions, with a balanced collection of potted ferns and small green plants. The coral surfaces must visibly remain the principal scene color; do not let a mass of dark green foliage dominate. Richly illustrated textures, dimensional terracotta pots, soft overhead natural light. Include distant pale-blue sky visible through a central high window for one later cloud detail. Reserve natural open positions for later foliage details without blank artificial holes.

sources.name: atlas
sources.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. ONE TRANSPARENT PRODUCTION SPRITE ATLAS for the layered scene "A sunlit glasshouse filled with ferns and potted plants". Polished warm storybook digital painting matching the approved Art Direction V2 game boards: tactile softly brushed surfaces, gentle sunlight, dimensional illustrated objects, clean local colour separation and rich small discoveries. No flat vector art, no photographic collage, no generic geometric filler. View/perspective: eye-level intimate view; same gentle light from upper left. Palette dominant coral pink (#D99B96) with natural object colours. Render exactly five independent painted foreground details on TRUE transparent alpha in a strict3-column by2-row grid, aspect3:2, target2400x1600. Each cell800x800, at least96pxtransparent gutter on every side; no overlap between cells. Bottom-right sixth cell MUST remain completely transparent. No labels, numbers, frames, sky backdrop or contact shadow. Paint only the requested detail for each cell; do not bake rectangular scenery around it. cell(1,1): an upper-left branch of the scene-specific plant; cell(2,1): an upper-right leaf cluster of a different scene plant; cell(3,1): a lower-left flower or fern frond; cell(1,2): a lower-right cluster of matching grass or foliage; cell(2,2): a small soft cloud or reflected-water glint suited to this scene. These details are actual parts of the completed painting, not generic decorative particles. Design each isolated silhouette to fit the placement and perspective of this exact scene.
Exactly these five isolated details, each compact and contained well inside its cell with large transparent separation: top-left a small jasmine vine sprig with five olive leaves and two tiny white flowers, stem attached at its lower-left end and extending upward-right; top-middle one slender upright banana-plant leaf with a short stalk below, fresh natural green with upper-left sunlight; top-right a single delicate fern frond with a long visible lower stem, curling gently toward the right; bottom-left a compact spider-plant tuft of five narrow green leaves with ivory central stripes, springing from one central base; bottom-middle one small soft ivory cloud with pale lavender shading, horizontally stretched, to appear in the blue upper windowpane. Bottom-right entirely empty. Match warm painted coral-pink glasshouse scene, no pots or window frame included, no rectangular background or ground shadows. No labels. TRUE transparent alpha.
